findings.claim: The recorded business-quality thesis needs a separate check of cash conversion and shareholder distribution capacity; the cited materials do not by themselves close that question.
findings.proposed_follow_up: Reconcile the cash-flow and distribution bases in the cited original filings.

findings.claim: A countercase is that the stated return driver may be more sensitive to margin or channel assumptions than the current thesis explains.
findings.proposed_follow_up: Compare the documented assumptions with the strongest adverse case; do not infer a new valuation.
